name: Ai ni Arazu
source:
A Yazuka member named Tetsuji gets raped by a beautiful man named Haruka, who disguised himself as a woman.
As he gets raped daily, unrest starts to spread throughout his syndicate.
What is this feeling born from hatred and obsession?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE271525.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
八冢成员铁二被女扮男装的美男子遥强奸。
由于他每天都被强奸，骚乱开始在他的集团中蔓延。
这种由仇恨和执念而生的感觉是什么？
